events.verdict: Grant (POR) is already in Wagner's (ORL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Banchero (ORL) initiates contact with Avdija's (POR) right arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Camara (POR) applies a collapsed forearm to Black's (ORL) upper body and the contact during the shot near the rim is marginal.
Avdija (POR) cleanly ties up Carter Jr. (ORL) and a jump ball is correctly called.
Grant (POR) initiates contact with Bane (ORL), who has established a legal guarding position in his path prior to the contact.
Bane (ORL) establishes himself in Grant's (POR) path and does not deliver contact.
Avdija (POR) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact from Black (ORL) as he contests the shot near the rim.
Carter Jr. (ORL) directly contests Avdija's (POR) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Avdija's hand after the release.
Avdija (POR) applies his right hand to Black's (ORL) upper body, and the contact on the perimeter is marginal.
Holiday (POR) directly contests Bane's (ORL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Bane's hand after the release.
Avdija (POR) dislodges Carter Jr. (ORL) from his legally obtained rebounding position.
Wagner (ORL) initiates contact with Sharpe's (POR) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court (defensive goaltending) was overturned to an inadvertent whistle.  Black (ORL) cleanly blocks Sharpe's (POR) shot attempt before the ball has reached its apex.
Banchero (ORL) brings his off-arm toward Grant's (POR) side, and the contact as they come together in transition is marginal.
Grant (POR) steps towards Banchero's (ORL) path as they come together, and the contact is marginal.
Grant (POR) commits a take foul on Banchero (ORL).
Banchero (ORL) initiates contact with Grant's (POR) arm that affects his play at the basket.
Banchero (ORL) does not overtly, or abruptly, veer into Camara (POR) as they come together during the drive.
Avdija (POR) initiates contact with Banchero's (ORL) arm as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Banchero (ORL) is moving alongside Holiday's (POR) path and cleanly steals the ball from Holiday, who loses control of the ball on his own.
Wagner (ORL) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Carter Jr. (ORL) establishes himself in Holiday's (POR) path and does not deliver contact.
Camara (POR) legally contests Bane's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
